Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying provisions relating to the possession of controlled substances.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the possession of controlled substances;amending RCW 69.50.4013 and 69.50.4014; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 69.50.4013 and 2003 c 53 s 334 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) It is unlawful for any person to knowingly possess a controlledsubstance unless the substance was obtained directly from, or pursuantto, a valid prescription or order of a practitioner while acting in thecourse of his or her professional practice, or except as otherwiseauthorized by this chapter. (2) Except as provided in RCW 69.50.4014, any person who violatesthis section is guilty of a class C felony punishable under chapter9A.20 RCW.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 69.50.4014 and 2003 c 53 s 335 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Except as provided in RCW 69.50.401(2)(c), any person found guilty p. 1 HB 1695of ((possession of)) knowingly possessing forty grams or less ofmarihuana is guilty of a misdemeanor.
